name: Jellyio Streams
description: Stream Stremio-addon content from your self-hosted AIOStreams instance. The plugin generates a Jellyfin library (.strm files plus nfo metadata) with a Stremio-like stream picker: each resolved stream becomes a selectable version of the item. Includes catalog sync, search & add, and a scheduled refresh task.
overview: Stream Stremio-addon content from a self-hosted AIOStreams instance

versions.changelog: Fix: scheduled task trigger now correctly uses IntervalTrigger type. Fixes a startup crash ('Info did not contain a TimeOfDayTicks') that prevented Jellyfin from starting when the plugin was enabled.
Initial release: catalog sync, search & add, version-based stream selection, scheduled refresh.
